science_relevance.scientific_problem: Compute accurate initial-value trajectories for spatially discretized heat diffusion in two dimensions with controlled numerical cost.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Stable and efficient integration is needed to simulate spatially discretized heat diffusion in two dimensions. This local model is an idealized numerical-method instance; it does not supply empirical measurements or establish a new physical law.

papers.title: Automatic Selection of Methods for Solving Stiff and Nonstiff Systems of Ordinary Differential Equations
papers.task_relation: Petzold develops a numerical integrator that changes methods according to stiffness to solve initial-value systems efficiently. This task implements the same numerical-solution objective for spatially discretized heat diffusion in two dimensions, with a local error-versus-evaluation-cost score and discretization.
papers.primary_goal: Improve the efficiency and reliability of solving stiff and nonstiff ordinary differential-equation initial-value systems.
